title: Exterior sheaves commute with open restriction
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal M$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $n\geq0$, and $U\subseteq X$ an open subscheme. For the exterior sheaf defined by sheafification of sectionwise exterior powers [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], there is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_U$-modules $(\bigwedge^n\mathcal M)|_U\cong\bigwedge^n(\mathcal M|_U)$. No local-freeness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: The old exteriorSheafPresheaf and upstream PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower agree: their objects are definitionally equal and their restriction maps agree by uniqueness on pure wedges. Sheafification carries this equality to exteriorSheaf M n = exteriorPower M n. Rewrite the two-sided morphism data from [lem-sc-exterior-sheaf-restrict-hom-data] using this equality at M and at its restriction, then package the mutually inverse morphisms as an isomorphism.

proof_origin.note: Retirement adaptation: use the upstream hom-data theorem via proved equalities of the exterior constructions, preserving the consumer signature and public imports.
